verdict.rationale: Groq's docs publicly list per-model pricing (e.g. groq-docs-38 shows exact $/token input/output pricing for gpt-oss-120b) directly on the models page without requiring sales contact, and flex/batch pricing notes are also public. However, only one model's price line is evidenced in the pack, not a full public price list for every hosted model, and there's no dedicated pricing page evidence confirming comprehensive coverage. missing for 10: a full public pricing table covering all hosted models, evidence of a dedicated /pricing page, and independent confirmation that all listed prices are current/accurate.
